scope: Read-only review of the frozen MAIN LUT submission package; no additional pixel-renderer research or application changes

original_instruction_checks.original_body_review: Scalar register setup, whole-word copy loops, conditional shadow update, DAIF save/restore, and return; no RGB pixel arithmetic

emulator.name: Unicorn
emulator.execution_state: EL1h, IRQ mask tested both set and clear
emulator.mmio: ordinary guarded emulator RAM; no device access

execution_review.guarding: Original instructions execute only in Unicorn; source pages are read-only, permitted data ranges checked, input ends meet unmapped guards, output compared over full64KiB RAM window; count100000 and timeout5seconds bound each case
execution_review.abi: x0 ordinary register-window RAM; w1 zero/nonzero module flag; x2 two valid input pointers; w3 valid8bit or sentinel shadow ID; x30 sentinel; EL1h PSTATE
execution_review.daif: Both IRQ-mask entry states are exercised; all DAIF mask bits are checked for restoration for those states. This is emulated privilege state, not host interrupt manipulation
execution_review.writes: Exact set of allowed32bit register locations and complete final RAM image verified. Temporal hardware behaviour and asynchronous application are not emulated
execution_review.fixtures: Deterministic synthetic full-width words, not vendor LUT contents or photographs

static_link_review.et_rel: Call targets are resolved through actual R_AARCH64_CALL26 relocations, not unrelocated branch immediates
static_link_review.lut_binding: Independently inspected .text+0x5a190..0x5a1c0: lut_probe relocation; componentID0x4e; component+0x50 receives mapped parent pointer from [[context+0x2a0]+0x48]
static_link_review.mapped_resource: Bounded .text+0x5c2d8..0x5c318 slice resolves platform_get_resource_byname and devm_ioremap_resource and stores result at resource+0x48; source report identifies yuv_pp_base
static_link_review.physical_link: librcam descriptors control0xf320001c, pre-gamma0xf3207f7c/33words, LUT0xf3208000/6144words agree with the original writer relative offsets; inferred parent physical base0xf3200000
static_link_review.main_pixel_meaning: No bank ordering, grid, input/output normalization, interpolation or rounding is inferred from register extents

recommended_scope_refinements: Use Generated probe binaries rather than Native binaries for the cleanup statement; separately supplied original firmware binaries remain inputs
State that which MAIN modules, if any, this particular RPC applies is unestablished, rather than only saying it has not been proved to apply every module
combined_checkpoint_review.other_domains: CCM and gamma mathematical results are separately independently reviewed; this review checked their stated scope but did not repeat those probes

limits: No physical camera or ISP execution
No full RPC handler or DSP ISA recovered
No new APK or app processing path
